_meta.notes: All money values per hectare per season (one crop cycle). Prices are farm-gate (precio al productor) unless labelled otherwise. Yields: 'typical' = INEC ESPAC 2024 production/harvested area for Guayas and Los Ríos (farmer-declared, monocrop 'Solo'); 'high' usually = MAG objective-yield (crop-cut) surveys, which run systematically higher than ESPAC — different methodology, not a time trend. Rice prices are for paddy at 20% moisture / 5% impurities (SIPA standard); maize at 13% / 1%. 'typical' price = simple mean of the 2025 SIPA monthly national weighted averages (2026 SIPA producer bulletins were not published at the expected URL as of 2026-11-14). Costs mix years and methodologies (academic farm surveys, CFN client references, grower-union statements in the press); whether land rent is included is stated per crop. Typical margin = yield.typical × price.typical − cost.typical is NOT stored; compute in the app. Derived values (unit conversions, cost/qq × qq/ha) are marked in 'derivations'. People quoted in press sources are not named here. Null means no usable source was found; see 'null_reasons'.

units.notes: SIPA producer bulletins quote rice per 'saca aprox. 200 lb'; the official minimum support price (PMS) and MAGP public purchase use a 205 lb saca. Market sacas of 210–220 lb are also reported. Convert with 1 lb = 0.45359237 kg.

espac_2024_lost_area_ha.notes: National totals, monocrop. Frost losses are Sierra plots. ESPAC counts only fully lost area, not partial yield loss, so these shares understate risk.

insurance.notes: Agroprotege insured sum per ha for 2024–2026 not found; 2023 maize example used (insured sum = cost of production, not lost revenue). diesel_subsidy_removal.notes: No source quantifies pumping cost per ha (gallons/ha). Diesel ~30% of rice cost is a grower-union claim; +20% total cost is a producer projection; maize 'a bit over USD 100/ha in fuel' is one grower's statement.
